summary: Lincoln County, MT 70-foot pole tower built 1934 in the Kootenai National Forest; destroyed in 1972 or 1975; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 70-foot pole tower, described as an L-4 tower
facts.status_note: firelookout.com says it was destroyed in either 1972 or 1975; the year is not settled

events.note: Listed as 1934: 70-foot pole L-4 tower on firelookout.com

evidence.supports: 70-foot pole tower, described as an L-4 tower
destroyed in either 1972 or 1975, year not given
FFLA lists it as a Tower at 48.65832, -115.27443, status Gone

notes_for_editor: Only firelookout.com gives this tower's history; FFLA confirms it as Gone. The destruction year is 1972 or 1975 with nothing to choose between them, so no destroyed event is entered. Height is converted from 70 feet (21.3 m). The Forest Lookouts Lincoln County page lists WAREX with only a township reference, so it is not cited. No photos were found. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 2 page reads.
